title: Varicose vein surgery
what: The surgeon removes enlarged veins on the leg through small cuts. Blood then flows through the healthy deep veins.
why: For marked varicose veins with swelling, heavy legs, or skin changes, when other methods are not suitable.
duration: surgery usually takes 1 to 2 hours; you usually go home the same day or after 1 to 2 days
tell_doctor: All your medicines, especially blood thinners and hormones
Past blood clots in the veins, in you or relatives

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: A vein ultrasound, blood tests, and an ECG. The clinic will give you a list. The day before, the doctor marks the veins with a pen.

prepare.title: Stockings
prepare.text: Buy a compression stocking in the right size and class in advance. Your doctor will tell you which.

prepare.title: Food
prepare.text: With general or spinal anesthesia, usually no food from the night before and no drinks for a few hours. The clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: Shower the day before. Sometimes you are asked to shave your leg. Check with the clinic.

steps: You change, and an IV line is placed
General, spinal, or local anesthesia is given
Through small cuts, the surgeon removes the enlarged veins
Sometimes the main vein is closed from inside with a laser or radiofrequency
The cuts are stitched or taped
A compression stocking or bandage goes on right away
feel: A pulling pain along the veins. You will get painkillers
Bruises on the leg for a few weeks
Sometimes a small numb patch of skin. It usually passes
after: Walk on the very first day. It protects against blood clots
Wear the stocking for as long as your doctor says
For a few weeks, no saunas, heavy lifting, or long sitting
A follow-up ultrasound on your doctor's schedule
red_flags: Severe pain and swelling of the whole leg: call your doctor
Sudden shortness of breath or chest pain: call emergency services
A fever over 38°C (100.4°F), or redness or pus at the cuts

faq.q: Is it harmful to remove veins?
faq.a: Only diseased surface veins are removed. Blood flows through the deep veins, and they cope.
Sometimes new enlarged veins appear. Exercise, stockings, and checkups with your doctor help.

reminders.text: Vein surgery tomorrow. Bring your compression stocking, documents, and comfortable shoes. Eat and drink only until the time the clinic gave you.
